shortDescription: Sends a text message to a mobile phone through Twilio

options.name: account_sid
options.description: User's Twilio account token found on the account page.

options.name: from_number
options.description: The Twilio number to send the text message from, format C(+15551112222).

options.name: media_url
options.description: A URL with a picture, video or sound clip to send with an MMS (multimedia message) instead of a plain SMS.

options.name: msg
options.description: The body of the text message.

options.name: to_numbers
options.description: One or more phone numbers to send the text message to, format C(+15551112222).
